title: Huly document showcase
description: A long editorial column, set right of centre on a pale band, that behaves like a live document: a blue cursor handle after the heading, a yellow-highlighted passage under a floating dark format toolbar, an image, struck-through and greyed words with an orange cursor, a dark code block, and a blinking prompt with a small action pill.
notes: the carets blink with CSS (off under reduced motion); no JavaScript
margin notes show on wide screens only
